evidence_label: diagnostic-build evidence (c72_diag_mirror, source SHA-256 a46cc55a73a77dfa5691e292451d18d4ec663a04fb5f07b39c6e91915010d437); establishes nothing about the exact c72 binary
assumptions: trial directories are <block>/<arm>/<trial>/; the arm is the parent directory name (off, timing_only, size_only, combined); trial.json carries label and master_port; one connection (one master SYN) per trial

out.pcap / in.pcap: classic pcap, tcpdump -s0 -Q out / -Q in on the master NIC (vision_run.py); out.pcap frames may carry the TX-offload placeholder TCP checksum, replaced by the NIC-computed checksum before comparison; no TSO/GSO split of master frames
mirror.pcap: classic pcap (not pcapng), tcpdump -s0 -Q in, promiscuous, on the capture interface, GRO/LRO off, no FCS in captured frames, no VLAN tag
out.pcap, in.pcap and mirror.pcap are timestamped by the same Vision host clock (E2 orders them)
mirror_capture.json: vision_run.MirrorCapture record; its tcpdump key is parse_tcpdump_stats of the mirror tcpdump (captured, received, dropped_kernel, dropped_interface)
mirror_iface_before.json / mirror_iface_after.json: MirrorCapture.identity (interface; driver = parsed ethtool -i; link = ip -j -s link show, whose stats64.rx.packets is the interface RX count)

the switch counter snapshots bracket the Vision step, so dev10/dev64 counters may include relay-leg frames outside the mirror capture window: copies against counters are bounds (copies <= counter), not equalities

snapshots/<label>_before.json and _after.json: snapshot_counters.py run with --ports 9,64,10; ports keyed by the port number as a string; $FramesReceivedOK / $FramesTransmittedOK are the counted frames
relay_wire.json: relay_check v3 output (sel751-wire-v3) of the same trial

an egress copy is a mirror frame whose Ethernet source is the master MAC seen in the master TCP copies (the switch rewrites no MAC); every other copy, including third-party broadcasts on the relay segment, is ingress
E1: mirror.pcap is preservation_check --relay-pcap (both mirror directions in one file)
